name: Android Drone Alarm
postCreateCommand: set -e; sudo mkdir -p /opt/android-sdk; cd /opt/android-sdk; curl -L -o cmdline-tools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip; unzip -o cmdline-tools.zip; mkdir -p cmdline-tools/latest; mv -f cmdline-tools/bin cmdline-tools/lib cmdline-tools/NOTICE.txt cmdline-tools/source.properties cmdline-tools/latest/; yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=/opt/android-sdk --licenses; /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=/opt/android-sdk "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0" "platform-tools"; grep -q ANDROID_HOME ~/.bashrc || echo 'export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk' >> ~/.bashrc; grep -q cmdline-tools/latest/bin ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH=$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin' >> ~/.bashrc
